outcome: Incidence of post dural puncture headache (PDPH)
Incidence of post dural puncture backache (PDPB)
Factors associated with PDPH and PDPB
cohort: 251 patients aged 18-40 years undergoing cesarean section under subarachnoid block at a tertiary care hospital between July 1, 2021, and December 31, 2021.
finding: The incidence of PDPH was 8.7%, and the incidence of PDPB was 4.7%, with several factors significantly associated with each condition.
